        claimant is both incapable of work and disabled if1

        1.    the training has ended and

        2.    the claimant was entitled to SDA within the 56 days immediately before the
              course started and

        3.    the first day after training ended

              3.1    is a day the claimant is incapable of work and

              3.2    is two years or less since the last day of entitlement to SDA.

Check governing headings, definitions, exceptions and current source.","text":"57061   A day of entitlement to DPTC is treated as a day on which a claimant is both
        incapable of work and disabled if1

        1.    the work in which a person is normally engaged has ceased and

        2.    there is entitlement to DPTC in the week which includes the day employment
              ends and

        3.    SDA was the qualifying benefit for entitlement to DPTC and

        4.    on the first day after employment ends the claimant is incapable of work and
              this day is two years or less since the last day of entitlement to SDA.
                                                                                 1 SS CB Act, s 68(10)

         the UK permanently

         1.    an EEA national who has resided in the UK in accordance with the Imm
                                                                                      1
               (EEA) Regs 2016 for a continuous period of five years or

         2.    family members of EEA nationals (who are not themselves EEA nationals)
               who have resided in the UK in accordance with the Imm (EEA) Regs 2016 for
                                                          2

         Note: Subject to DMG 073360, a break in continuity during which residence is not in
         accordance with the Imm (EEA) Regs will mean that the five year qualifying period
         has to be served afresh.
